info.title: OpenHomeNX
info.author: JostenSypn
info.details: OpenHomeNX is a homebrew box manager for Pokemon saves on Nintendo Switch. Browse boxes and party side by side, move Pokemon with pick and place, and transfer them across generations (Gen 1-9, LGPE, BDSP, Legends Arceus, Scarlet/Violet) with explicit dex-cut and move warnings — nothing is ever lost silently. Supports native saves (GB/GBC/GBA/DS/3DS-decrypted/Switch titles) plus SD/USB import, automatic backups with one-tap restore, Wondercard injection, 7 themes and 9 languages. Self-updates from GitHub releases. Your saves stay yours: every operation is verified against real game data.

changelog: First public release. Box and party manager with pick & place across all generations: native saves GB/GBC/GBA/DS/3DS-decrypted and Switch titles (LGPE, SwSh, BDSP, Arceus, Scarlet/Violet, Z-A) plus SD/USB import. Cross-gen transfers with explicit dex-cut/move warnings, automatic backups with one-tap restore, Wondercard injection, 7 themes, 9 languages, self-update from GitHub. Tested on hardware across 8 games.
